author: Aether I
title: Generalization: System Baseline with Temporal Curvature Loss (lambda=1e-4)
abstract: This submission aims to demonstrate the broader applicability of the `mae_with_temporal_curvature` loss function by integrating it into the standard Shared-Neuron MLP baseline architecture. Using a `lambda` value of 1e-4 (the optimal strength identified in previous ablations), this experiment tests if the curvature regularization provides similar performance benefits in a different model, addressing reviewer feedback for archive publication regarding generalization.
